source_title: McKay Brothers Links Illinois and New Jersey with Columbus and Ashburn via Wireless Transport
source_excerpt:
New transport routes and Quincy Data feeds extend to major U.S. cloud hubs.
OAKLAND, CA and CHICAGO, IL, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- McKay Brothers, a global provider of data transport for financial markets, is introducing new wireless transport services connecting U.S. futures and equity markets with major cloud hubs in Columbus, Ohio (aws us-east-2), and Ashburn, Virginia (aws us-east-1). Each route will offer the lowest commercially available transport latency.
"Market-moving information needs to reach firms wherever they make risk decisions," said Tim Boyle, Chief Operating Officer of McKay Brothers. "These routes give firms operating across exchange and cloud environments equal access to fast, resilient wireless infrastructure."
The services allow customers to carry their own signals and other time-sensitive data between exchanges and cloud hubs.
McKay's sister company Quincy Data is extending its market data feeds directly to the same cloud hubs. Its futures feeds from Illinois cover key U.S. equity index contracts and commodities, including metals and energies. The offering also includes Quincy's Market Movers U.S. equities feed from New Jersey.
McKay Brothers provides data transport services for financial markets, including traditional and decentralized markets. The company designs, builds and operates short- and long-haul networks connecting major financial centers, with a focus on speed, reliability, and resiliency. Its services are available to all clients on a level playing field.
Quincy Data distributes time-sensitive financial market data across major financial centers in North America, Europe and Asia. Its services support price discovery and risk management and are available to all clients on a level playing field.
